sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbNM' and n['pixels']>=16:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
print('now:', snap(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print('after UP:', snap(current_frame), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
